skills.name: SQLMap POST/body: Assess a form POST field
skills.description: Check one approved form field through the structured body interface.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Use an owner-approved request body from a test account or fixture; avoid real user data.
2. Set `method` to the expected method and supply the body through `data`; select one field with `parameter` when possible.
3. Set `method=POST`, put the original test form body in `data`, name the field with `parameter`, and retain low-impact defaults.
4. Add only required headers and keep the scan profile conservative.

Safety: test only explicitly authorized scope with uthorized_target=true. Do not send live personal data, dump records, use shells/server file access, evade controls, or perform destructive actions.
